description: This file initializes and manages a Supabase client for a React web application, including environment validation, diagnostics, and client caching.

methods.name: maskSecret
methods.description: Masks a secret string for logging, showing only the first 6 characters and length.

methods.name: validateEnv
methods.description: Validates environment variables for correct format and presence.

methods.name: logDiagnosticsOnce
methods.description: Logs environment diagnostics once to the console, including URL and key info without exposing secrets.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates and caches the Supabase client after validating environment variables.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient
methods.description: Returns the cached Supabase client instance or throws an error if misconfigured.

methods.name: getSupabaseDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns minimal diagnostics about the Supabase environment configuration.
